claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft is expected to create a powerful sonic boom over Southern California on April 10, 2026.
The sonic boom occurs during the Artemis II Orion spacecraft's high-speed re-entry at ~24,000 mph.
The sonic boom occurs around 5 p.m. to 5:15 p.m. PT.
A video explains how researchers will use the sonic boom from the Artemis II re-entry to calibrate their sensors.
